BisonHub Help Index for Faculty and Staff BisonHub on the Go - Download the Workday Mobile App Today! One of the major benefits of the BisonHub system is the ability to access the system anytime, anywhere. BisonHub, powered by Workday, is a cloud-based system that allows users (students, faculty, and staff) to access the system on a mobile device. Maximize your access and ease of use and download the Workday mobile app today. Use the attached resource for directions on how to download the app and access BisonHub. BisonHub on the Go - Download the Workday Mobile App Today! BisonHub At A Glance Faculty & Staff Howard faculty and staff currently use BisonHub powered by Workday for finance, human resources, procurement, and payroll, and will soon use it for student specific modules including Admissions, Advising, and Financial Aid. The implementation of the student-specific modules begins in Summer 2023 and culminates in Fall 2024. Students Howard students will begin to use BisonHub in Spring 2024 for advising and registration for Fall 2024 classes. BisonHub will replace many of the functions currently available in Bison Web. What's New This website will be your “go-to” location to learn more about BisonHub powered by Workday. Bookmark this website to stay up to date on all things BisonHub including ways to get involved and be part of this exciting change at the University! Warren Petty, Ed.D.
